Our Story

Camp built on love, powered by community.

Born in 1968 out of a father's wish for his daughter, Camp Adam Fisher is the largest and oldest all-volunteer camp for kids with Type 1 diabetes in the Southeast.

Our mission: to offer all the experiences, lessons and benefits of summer camp to children with T1D, while teaching them how to live longer and healthier lives — in a safe, well-monitored environment where professional attention is afforded to each camper's individual needs.

It's simple really. A week of camp, packed with great activities, fun, friendship and self-discovery.
